name: @oge-ui/pivot-engine
description: Framework-free pivot grid engine behind @oge-ui/pivot (Angular) and @oge-ui/react-pivot (React): field layout model, axis and header layout math, two-axis virtualization windows, the remote-store adapter, header and measure menus, value filters, the field chooser, keyboard navigation, persistence snapshots, the message catalog and the Excel workbook builder. Source-available commercial license (free for evaluation and development).
